TOOLING BURST FL-2c — canonical capsule collider for G1 (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; conductor design ruling R-C5-96). task_id "FL-2c".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b, T4f, FL-1b, FL-2, FL-2b and the new row "FL-2c — canonical capsule collider (art is art)" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (the G1 sweep: the 3-px CircleShape2D HitShape, the FL-2/FL-2b painted-envelope code, release_sweep_start, fraction/along ordering, forward test), export/effect_kit.py (G1 kit validation — add the optional field), runs/C-5/cliffside_v35/ (staged real scene, READ ONLY), runs/C-5/conductor_scripts/probe_events.gd (KIT_CYCLES, FACE), runs/C-5/t3/FL-2b/acceptance.json (part_a before/after), runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json, runs/C-5/specs/ice_bolt_e2.json, the fire arms' and ice kit.json, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

RULING TO IMPLEMENT (R-C5-96): gameplay collision must not depend on which pixels a painting covers. (1) The G1 projectile collider is a CapsuleShape2D: radius = `collision_radius_bh` × 130 px (new optional kit field under the G1 block; default 0.25; validate 0.1–0.5), length = the head primitive's drawn length along the direction (rear socket → tip), oriented along the flight direction, its rear at the release socket; the 3-px circle and the FL-2/FL-2b painted-envelope collision code are RETIRED (delete, do not leave dead paths). (2) The sweep: the same emergence + per-frame cast_motion/intersect_shape logic over the capsule, hits ordered by fraction then along. (3) A contact counts only if (target.global_position − release_socket)·facing ≥ 0.25 BH (32.5 px); nearer/behind bodies are ignored (never struck, never excluded-forever — they may be struck later in flight if the capsule reaches them ahead). (4) Contact position recorded = the capsule's leading tip at the hit fraction; impact peaks at that tip; ground decals at the struck target's ground point (FL-2 Part 0b unchanged). (5) Applies to every G1 kit (fire arms, ice, orb + orb children use their own radius: orb children default 0.15).

Trace clauses (probe_events on a re-export of the v35 inputs into runs/C-5/t3/FL-2c/reexport/, FACE per direction, from (3760,640)): fire E → contact body 3 (shield) age ≤ 6; ice E → contact body 3 age ≤ 8 with the crown decal within 0.2 BH of (3911,596); fire SE, W, NW → no contact, range fizzle (expire age ≥ 18); fire N → expire age ≥ 18; fire NE → first contact is whichever target the capsule crosses first (report it); plus the FL-1a/FL-1b/FL-2 retained clauses (halo, release side, fizzle, cast half, embers) re-run unchanged.

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-2c/acceptance.json): the seven-direction probe outputs; capsule parameters per kit; 17 kits byte-identical (the field is optional — absent = default; kit.json untouched); full catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0; in-sandbox suite with the named tests green and remaining reds NAMED with the last traceback line; byte locks: if the emitted scene text changes, re-baseline with the FL-1b diff-summary rule.

Tests (unittest, stdlib): the direction clauses; the field validation; extend/realign only the named tests. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-2c/; fixtures/ only for byte-lock re-baselines with diffs. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy. Do not delete anything outside runs/C-5/t3/FL-2c/ (FL-2b's suite removed a T4x fixture dir — do not repeat: run RenderedLookTraceTests only with its cleanup confined or skip it with the reason named).
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-2c"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
